_source: Peng, Ren, Dudarev, Whelan, Acta Cryst. A52, 456 (1996), DOI 10.1107/S010876739600089X. Table 1 (Debye-Waller factors B = 8 pi^2 <u_x^2> in A^2), transcribed by hand from the printed page image. The printed table only covers 85-280 K and omits the 100/150/200/250 K rows; rows at 85 and 90 K are inconsistent for Ge and are not used. Si rows 110-160 K are internally inconsistent in the print, so only rows >= 170 K are kept. The extended 1-1000 K table is deposited with the IUCr (ZH0008) and was not available.

Ir.source: Peng et al. 1996 Table 2 (Debye temperature 420 K, from Kittel 1971); Ir is not in Table 1. Pure Debye estimate, approximate.
